clips.title: The story
paras: Training the Beast is a foundational quest for young hunters, directing them to seek out the veteran woodsman Isaac Chan in Goldshire. By completing this step, hunters learn to properly train, nourish, and revive their animal companions, transforming a freshly tamed beast into a loyal combat partner.

Learning to tame a wild creature is only the initial step for an aspiring hunter; maintaining a lasting partnership demands discipline and knowledge. The quest directs fledgling hunters to seek out Isaac Chan, an experienced woodsman stationed in Goldshire, to acquire the essential craft of beast training. Without proper guidance, a tamed beast remains an unruly wild animal rather than a steadfast ally in the wilderness.

Upon arriving in Goldshire, Isaac Chan bestows the skills necessary to care for an animal companion. This instruction goes beyond simple combat commands, encompassing the vital duties of feeding the companion to keep it satisfied and learning the rites to revive it should it fall in battle. Chan reminds his pupils that wielding power over wildlife comes with the duty to respect natural balance and live in awe of the surrounding world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.
Go with the winds, young adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A fledgling adventurer, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember, friend, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
